description: Source code for PCRE matching and substitution functions used in mod_redirect and mod_rewrite of lighttpd, including regex compilation, matching, substitution, and URL normalization.

classes.name: pcre_keyvalue
classes.description: Structure representing a compiled PCRE regex and associated data, with conditional members for PCRE2 or PCRE.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_buffer_init
methods.description: Initializes a new buffer for storing multiple keyvalue regex entries.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_buffer_append
methods.description: Appends a new regex pattern and associated data to the buffer, compiling the regex and preparing for matching.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_buffer_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the keyvalue buffer and its contained regex objects.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_buffer_process
methods.description: Processes input data against stored regexes, performing substitutions based on matches.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_burl_normalize_key
methods.description: Normalizes URL key patterns by uppercasing hex characters and encoding UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: pcre_keyvalue_burl_normalize_value
methods.description: Normalizes URL replacement patterns similarly to keys, preparing for regex substitution.
